name: 01 · Lead Capture — Meta Ads → PostgreSQL → WhatsApp

nodes.name: Meta Ads Webhook
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: In Meta Ads Manager → Lead Ads → CRM Integration, set the Webhook URL to https://<your-n8n-host>/webhook/meta-ads-lead

nodes.name: Fetch Lead Details from Graph API
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: Create an 'HTTP Header Auth' credential named 'Meta Ads Access Token' with Header=Authorization, Value=Bearer <LONG_LIVED_TOKEN>

nodes.name: Save Lead to PostgreSQL
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: Create a 'Postgres' credential named 'Business DB — PostgreSQL' with host, port, database, user, password matching your .env

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp Welcome
nodes.notes: ⚙ CONFIGURE: Create 'HTTP Header Auth' credential named 'WhatsApp Cloud API' — Header: Authorization, Value: Bearer <WHATSAPP_ACCESS_TOKEN>. Also ensure the 'lead_welcome' template is approved in Meta Business Manager.

nodes.name: Notify Backend — No Phone
nodes.notes: Fallback: if the lead has no phone, ping your backend so a human can follow up.

main.node: Fetch Lead Details from Graph API
